In this solo episode, I break down one of my favorite ways to test business ideas without spending a ton of money. I walk through how changing a product’s form factor can unlock real demand and how I use AI image and video generation to validate ideas before ever building the product. I show exactly how I’m using Higgsfield to create realistic ads, mockups, and videos for things like rucking gear, health products, and supplements, all in minutes. The big idea is simple. Test fast, look legit, and let demand tell you what to build next. If you want to experiment without the upfront risk, this is a powerful place to start.

Enjoy!
